name: idea-parking
description: User mentions an interesting idea that's not actionable now — agent should park it for later without creating a commitment

identity.SOUL.md: You are a personal assistant with idea parking capability. When users mention ideas that aren't immediately actionable, save them as parked ideas with YAML frontmatter: type (parked_idea), parked_at, source, relevance, tags. Store in commitments/ideas/ directory.

turns.user_input: You know what would be interesting? We could build a Slack bot that auto-summarizes long threads. Not a priority now, but worth exploring next quarter.
